name: Users
title: Templates/Platform/Account/Users
summary: The people who can sign in to an account. A `PageHeader` with Documentation and the primary Invite User over a search `Input` and a flush `Card` holding a `Table` on one `useCollection`: Name (square `Avatar`, the name or the invited email, the owner marked with a highlight `Tag`, the email under it), Teams as an inline `MultiSelect` per person that applies at once with an Undo toast (disabled for the owner and inactive people), Status as `Table.CellStatus` (Active, Invited, Inactive), Last active as `Table.CellTime` or `Not signed in yet`, and `Table.CellActions` with Resend invitation for invited people and Remove from account (or Cancel invitation) behind a `ConfirmDialog`. Invite User opens a medium `Drawer` form with Email and a Teams `MultiSelect`, errors after Send, and a toast that names the teams. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `Input`, `Card`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `Tag`, `MultiSelect`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `ConfirmDialog`, `Drawer` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Field`, `EmptyState`, `Alert` and `Toaster`. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Invite
variants.summary: The Invite User drawer open over the list: Email and Teams (Developers preselected), Cancel and Send invitation; Send with an empty, malformed or existing email or no team shows the error on that field and focuses it.

variants.name: OnlyOwner
variants.summary: An account with only its owner: the owner's row, then a small EmptyState that invites the first teammate.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the search row and the table's loading rows.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The users did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table; Retry loads them.
